msg: Hi, I'm Advanced and my last dive was 6 months ago. I'd like to dive on Thursday from Cartagena. My flight leaves that same Thursday at 11 pm. Is that OK?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

No—an 11 p.m. flight on the same day is too soon after diving. Certified divers need to wait at least 18 hours after their last dive before flying. A daytime dive from Cartagena ends around 12–1 p.m., so the earliest flight would be 7 a.m. the next day. The return time to Cartagena doesn’t change that.

And how many people should I plan for? That way I can give you the exact price. 😊
